messages:
Rahul P: quick sync - product wants a predictable per-route deprecation story for v1. main asks: no surprise billing, clear telemetry split, and easy console controls.
Eve L: agree. propose three-mode flow: preview (no billing/quota), staged (gradual weight shift), and cutover (full). preview should run a sampled simulation and show CI.
Joan M: telemetry: we need stable metric names. suggestion: `deprecation.cohort.{control,preview,live}_count`, `deprecation.latency.p95_delta_ms`, `deprecation.quality.regress_pct`, `deprecation.billing.estimated_delta_usd`. tag keys: route_id, tenant_id, deprecation_mode.
Zoe C: UX: banner on route page when a route is eligible. banner copy: "v2 available — preview cost & quality before switching" with a "Run preview" CTA. Preview modal shows est cost +/- CI, p95 delta, top 3 sample prompts (redacted), and a privacy toggle.
deprecation-bot: NOTE: enabling preview emits `route.deprecation.preview.started` and auto-creates a temporary dashboard named "Deprec Preview - <route_id> - <ts>".
Rahul P: routing sketch: router checks header `X-Redwood-Version` then route.deprecation.state. preview -> sample to v2 for analysis but primary stays on v1. staged -> increment v2 weight by configured `step_pct` every `step_minutes`.
Eve L: safety: previews must not count toward hard quotas or be billed. show a `preview_quota_estimate` series separately. live/staged moves should honor tenant quotas and billing.
Joan M: alerts: auto-pause staged rollout when `deprecation.quality.regress_pct` > 2% for 15m or `deprecation.latency.p95_delta_ms` > 50ms for 10m. ops-bot to open incident and notify route owner.
Zoe C: console features: per-route toggle for preview/staged/cutover, a slider for transition minutes, and a small timeline of deprecation events (audit log). require explicit confirmation for tenants with >1M req/day.
Rahul P: billing nuance: when shadowing (preview) we show estimated billing delta but do not invoice. add `deprecation.billing.estimated_delta_usd_ci_high` and `_ci_low` for transparency.
Joan M: implementation note: tag every request with `deprecation_cohort: control|preview|live` and emit trace spans with that tag so we can tie regressions to traces. ensure metric names are frozen before GA.
Eve L: privacy: redact user_content in stored samples; only keep prompt hashes + metadata. provide tenant opt-out for storing preview outputs.
Zoe C: small UX ask: add a confidence meter (0-100) next to banner derived from eval regressions and sample size.
ops-bot: ALERT: if `deprecation.billing.estimated_delta_usd` > 50% for 1h during staged move -> pause and notify finance + owner.
Rahul P: action items: Joan -> RFC for metric names and tags. Eve -> modal copy + privacy opt-out flow. Zoe -> console mock for controls + timeline. I'll own runbook for auto-pause and rollback. Target alpha behind feature flag in 3 weeks.
Zoe C: will mock designs by Tue.
Joan M: opening RFC PR today.
Eve L: will draft privacy wording and opt-out option.
Rahul P: i'll link tickets here when created. thanks everyone. end.
